free_tier.stated: Free Starter: up to 25 recordings per person, 5 minutes per video, 50 members. Not a storage quota — a recording-count quota.

tooling: yt-dlp `loom` extractor (verified present; `loom:folder` marked CURRENTLY BROKEN). Loom has no public upload API.
chaining: 25 videos x 5 min x unlimited accounts. At 5 minutes a clip and a generous 10 Mbps that is ~375 MB per account — five orders of magnitude short of the 500 GB filter.
limits_note: 25 videos and 5 minutes are the ceiling; both are product limits on recording, not storage, and the web uploader enforces the same shape.
reliability_note: Deletion of old recordings is the norm on free tiers; 25 slots means you must delete to re-record, so it can never accumulate.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
